description: This is the official account for the National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD). The NTAD is a program within the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) at the United States Department of Transportation (USDOT). To access the NTAD Open Data Catalog, see: https://geodata.bts.gov. For more information on NTAD, please visit: https://www.bts.gov/ntad. If you have any questions, concerns, or feedback, please contact us.✉ ntad@dot.gov
